kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Probably an elistic name of Aramaic and ultimately Akkadian origin. For metrical considerations it could still have tanwīn in spite of being, as a proper noun, diptote.
Probably an elistic name of Aramaic and ultimately Akkadian origin. For metrical considerations it could still have tanwīn in spite of being, as a proper noun, diptote.
g: a copious source of nourishment, used to aggrandize the contents of a book or a restaurant for marketing purposes, in reference to the Qurʔānic description of Paradise
